title: ASMOSIA XIII : Proceedings of the 13th International Conference of the Association for the Study of Marble and Other Stones In Antiquity. Vienna, 19–24 September 2022, Volume 2
summary: The book contains the proceddings of the ASMOSIA XIII Conference held in 2022 inVienna which is the largest conference dealing with »Marbel in Antiquity«. This volume contains more than 70 scientific contributions from international participants of the conference from 22 countiries all over the world. Volume 1: https://e-book.fwf.ac.at/o:2044 Volume 2: https://e-book.fwf.ac.at/o:2045
